Description: Successful zero-knowledge registration and automatic login
Test Steps:
1. Fill legal name email and password
2. Request and verify OTP
3. Complete registration handshake
4. Confirm redirect to dashboard
Expected Result: User is registered and auto-logged in; credentials persisted

Description: Validate invalid email input during onboarding registration
Test Steps: 1. Enter "invalid-email"\n2. Enter password\n3. Click Begin Protocol
Expected Result: Client prevents form submission or displays email validation error

Description: Verify OTP verification code fails with wrong/invalid OTP
Preconditions: OTP code is sent to email
Test Steps: 1. Enter incorrect 6-digit OTP code\n2. Click Verify & Create Vault
Expected Result: Error toast is displayed and registration is aborted

Description: Decrypt real name and unlock vault with correct password
Expected Result: Session token stored; master key derived; display name decrypted; redirected to dashboard

Description: Incorrect password displays error and denies entry
Test Steps: 1. Enter correct email but wrong password\n2. Click Unlock Vault

Description: Added assets are persisted across reload/re-login
Test Steps:
1. Click Add Asset
2. Submit name and value
3. Reload page
4. Check asset list
Expected Result: Asset is securely encrypted and persists after reload
Notes: FAILING: Added assets are never persisted locally (silent data loss)

Description: Modified asset details are saved to backend/storage
Test Steps:
1. Select asset
2. Click Edit
3. Change value and Save
4. Reload page
Expected Result: Updated asset value persists after reload
Notes: FAILING: updates are only local Zustand state and never hit API/storage
